description: Local business leads: up to 10 Google Maps businesses for a search and place, each with address, phone, website, rating, reviews, plus emails (checked), phones and social profiles found on its website. Use to find businesses of a kind in a place with ways to contact them, e.g. 'dentists in Austin, TX' or 'hotels in Pokhara'. Returns summary counts and leads[] {name, category, address, phone, website, rating, reviews, mapsUrl, contacts {emails[] with deliverability, phones[], socials}}. Price: $0.10 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

contacts.description: Visit each website for emails, phones and social links (default true)

language.description: Language for Maps fields, e.g. en (default)

limit.description: Businesses to return, up to the tier cap (10 or 20)

location.description: Where, e.g. Kathmandu, Nepal or Austin, TX (optional if the query names the place)

query.description: What to search for on Google Maps, e.g. dentists, coworking space, hotels

name: leads

cached.description: Present and true when the answer came from Exepal's cache

contacts.description: From the business's own website; absent when it has none

checked.description: False when the website could not be read

deliverable.description: likely, risky, undeliverable, unknown or unchecked

title: Local business leads (Google Maps)
